issues.title: 1 mm bottom chamfer
issues.message: Recommend adding 1mm chamfer to the base of all parts for maximum reliability and highest tolerance.

issues.title: Minimum thickness 0.5 mm
issues.message: Thinnest wall is 0.40 mm (limit 0.50 mm), across about 93.8 mm² of the part. Walls this thin may print with gaps or not at all.
issues.suggestion: Thicken thin walls, fins and plates to at least 0.5 mm — 1.2 mm or more for strength.

issues.title: No thin vertical stalks
issues.message: A column about 3.3 mm wide and 60.5 mm tall (18.2× taller than wide) may wobble while printing and snap off during handling.
issues.suggestion: Thicken the column to at least 2 mm, add a fillet or brace at its base, or print it lying down.

issues.title: Requires Support
issues.message: About 416 mm² of overhangs (35° or less from horizontal) will need support. Highlighted areas show where.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part so fewer surfaces face downward, or add chamfers under overhangs.

issues.title: Flat on the bed
issues.message: Only 28.2 mm² of the bottom sits flat on the bed (needs about 50.0 mm²). The part may come loose during printing.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part so its largest flat face is on the bottom, or add a flat base before exporting.

issues.title: 1 mm bottom chamfer

issues.title: Potential Excessive Support
issues.message: Estimated support is about 212% of the part's volume (26.6 cm³ of support for 12.6 cm³ of part). Highlighted areas overhang 35° or less from horizontal.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part to reduce overhangs, add chamfers under overhangs, or split it into pieces that print flat.

issues.title: No text on the bottom
issues.message: The bottom face has 4 small shapes cut into or raised from it — likely text or a logo. Fine detail on the bed side prints poorly and can make the part rock.
issues.suggestion: Move text and logos to a side or the top of the part, or make the lettering at least 2 mm wide.
